name: netnewswire-mcp-readonly
description: Read-only fork: browse, fetch and search your NetNewsWire articles from Claude. No write tools.
long_description: Read-only fork of jellllly420/netnewswire-mcp by stefanstr. Connects Claude to NetNewsWire via AppleScript on macOS. The mark_articles and subscribe tools are removed, get_articles gains a sinceDays filter and a 300 s timeout, and the running check no longer needs System Events.

tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: List all subscribed feeds and folders, optionally filtered by account.

tools.name: get_articles
tools.description: Fetch articles with filters: unread, starred, by feed or folder, arrived within N days.

tools.name: read_article
tools.description: Get the full content of a specific article by ID (pass feedUrl to disambiguate).

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search articles by keyword across all feeds.
